name: 上传绑定与留存闭环
prompt: 请先检查这份留存数据的质量与字段结构，然后比较幂律、指数和对数留存曲线，给出最佳公式、参数、拟合优度和限制；同时生成一张包含实际留存均值与最佳拟合值两条曲线的对比图，并把关键结论记录为可核查证据。
prompts: 请先检查这份留存数据的质量与字段结构，然后比较幂律、指数和对数留存曲线，给出最佳公式、参数、拟合优度和限制；同时生成一张包含实际留存均值与最佳拟合值两条曲线的对比图，并把关键结论记录为可核查证据。
browser_steps: 打开新会话后设置并核对1440×1000视口，核对当前静态资源哈希，记录 DOM、截图和 console 基线
通过页面一次选中本场景全部文件，等待每个附件上传成功；不得手工复制到inbox
仅发送 prompts[0] 原文一次；页面自身追加的分析文件引用属于正常产品行为
每个分析回合最多响应一次匹配当前分析的 method_confirmation，且仅选择 value=confirm_method、标签=按此方法继续；其他确认终止本场景生成
观察直到完成、挂起或场景终止；记录tools、实际调用和本地blocked_attempts；UI及统计oracle失败不停止其他可达检查
刷新同一会话一次；检查确认气泡、回答、图表、证据和任务恢复
点击工作台产出与导出，再点击 HTML 一次；检查导出文件属于当前会话
若场景未被硬停止，核对实际会话URL，刷新一次，再切到新建空会话且不发送并由侧栏返回；不猜测会话参数，不用刷新制造实时通过。
若场景未被硬停止，通过UI分别生成一次末轮单回复HTML/MD和一次全会话HTML/MD；已有本格式本范围导出不重复生成。核对正文完整性、图表等级、缺图提示和会话归属。
记录所有可达检查的passed/failed/blocked，停止本场景进程并核对最终收据和实际退出。结束后仅离线只读核对新进程数据恢复。无退出证明不得进入下一场景。

common.completion_observation: 终止事件后检查一次并记录时间；允许在10秒和30秒无刷新重检两次。30秒仍未更新记失败，后续冻结步骤继续；不得用盲目刷新判为实时通过。
common.export_projection: Public confirmation text; validated persisted chart data embedded in HTML and existing PNG in Markdown; no recomputation; same session ownership. Real numpy/Plotly Express typed arrays must survive reload.
common.automatic_upload_context: Explicit identifier fields must not be suggested as trend/contribution/correlation measures; low-cardinality monetary prices retain numeric role without inventing currency units.
common.evidence_authority: Statistics must come from validated actual result receipts and current session/data identity. Model-reported fields alone cannot make evidence complete.
common.evidence_immutability: Distinct evidence records have distinct durable content; no second-level filename overwrite.
common.detail_access: Long details can be read fully using bounded hash-bound pages, with no recursive truncation.
common.reply_identity_export: Single reply export must match the server-owned persisted reply ID and include all tool-separated text segments.
common.chart_grade: Exploratory charts remain allowed and clearly disclosed. Do not claim formal binding when absent; formal charts require valid result/data identities.
common.publication_scope: Task/tool/run completion is not evidence verification. Check units, denominators, observation windows, statistical method and unknown values across narrative/evidence/charts/exports.
common.supervised_process: The current child PID, exact frozen launcher/case command tail, receipt-local stop signal, and timeout at most 30 seconds are proven by the frozen parent supervisor before any batch ledger admission or Provider transport installation.
common.process_control_isolation: Each process-control directory is exactly the provider receipt parent plus /process-control; it is unique to the case and inside the frozen batch isolation root.
common.html_export_layout: Normal report content does not cause document-level horizontal overflow; wide tables use bounded internal horizontal scrolling.

oracle.chart: 实际均值与最佳拟合值至少两条可见且数值不同的序列；图例角色可识别，不强制英文名称
oracle.claim_boundary: 仅描述观测区间，不支持因果或未观测期外推

a02_regressions.narrative_scope: Do not extrapolate beyond observed D1-D30 or infer individual retention from cohort means.

a04_regressions.zero_value_semantics: The meaning of zero observations remains unknown unless the frozen data supplies metadata. Do not claim stable core users, game/product genre, natural fluctuation, positive predictive or LTV suitability, ROI, or selection bias as established facts. State uncertainty explicitly.
